info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Servicing Servicing Orders-spec
info.description: The Servicing Orders Retrieval API enables users to access detailed information about servicing orders within the banking system. This endpoint allows for the retrieval of order data, supporting business operations such as account management and service fulfillment. Typical consumers of this API include banking personnel, customer support teams, and third-party system integrators looking to enhance their service offerings. Efficiently manage and track servicing orders by leveraging this well-defined API.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the details of a servicing order. It returns information about the order's status, associated customer, and item specifications.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving servicing order information. This should contain the necessary details specified in the schema to fetch the appropriate servicing order.

ListServicingServicingOrdersRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to servicing orders. The content of the request body is of type string.

sort.description: The sort criteria applied to the items.

ListServicingServicingOrdersResponse_200.description: A response schema representing the result of a servicing order retrieval operation.
